messages:
Nina (CS): Quick capture from MeridianHealth onboarding: recurring asks — per-route cost numbers, per-route embedding pin, and a one-page onboarding checklist with sample prompts. They said lack of per-route granularity blocks internal chargebacks and could delay renewal.

Paul (PM): Can you paste exact phrasing and which routes they referenced?

Nina (CS): Verbatim: 
- "We need cost by endpoint so our finance team can bill product squads."
- "If embedding costs spike we want to lock to a cheaper model for search routes."
- "A one-pager checklist with recommended starter prompts would have helped us deploy faster."
They mentioned `patient-inbox-summarize` and `clinic-search-embeds`.

Ivy (Product): Triage: checklist + prompts = immediate low-effort win; CSV export of per-route cost = short-term stopgap; full Console UI + billing rollups = longer. Embedding-pin per-route = medium effort.

Jorge (Eng): For CSV export we need route_id in billing aggregation, an auth'd endpoint, and a small scheduler. Estimate: ~2 dev days. Embedding-pin = metadata override + runtime lookup, ~3 dev days.

Nina (CS): I'll open cs:feedback ticket with quotes & examples. Recommend we mark MeridianHealth as at-risk if no CSV within 8 business days. Also request a CSM one-pager to set expectations.

OpsBot: JIRA ticket CS-5150 created by Nina (CS) — "MeridianHealth: per-route cost CSV + embed-pin + checklist" — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/CS-5150

Paul (PM): Action items: Nina opens ticket (done); Product to draft checklist; Eng to scope CSV & embed-pin and post estimates. Flagging CSV as P0 quick-win for retention.

Jorge (Eng): Adding CS-5150 to sprint buffer; will post PR & sample CSV in thread when ready.

Ivy (Product): Drafting checklist now, will share for CS review.
